title: STIGMERGY — rich
forward_vector: I am the manifest of STIGMERGY's rich face: five pieces in the board's own phosphor, each walking up to a test of the claim beside it — one line read by a person and an agent, saying done against showing done, coordination by trace and where it stops, the inbox cleared in one pass, and the handoff ladder with its scent that is a lease — plus the morning's Find the Ask beside the look. I grow when the page is relaid; I never hold its words.

pieces.title: find the ask
pieces.caption: The test the colour rule rests on: one ask or flag hidden in 24 lines of real board traffic, found by colour, by none, or with every agent its own colour. One player, nine rounds, and its fixed shuffle dealt two of the reserved-colour rounds first, while the game was still being learned; "under two seconds" is one reserved round, at 1.7 s. It plays once per browser, and its last screen speaks to the morning's player, not to you.

offers.what: STIGMERGY.md says "you cannot fake completion when the surface itself reconciles QUEUE against LOG", and § The coordination schema says "reconciliation closes QUEUE items when git proves the work happened". The terminal has git auto-reconciliation switched off since 2026-07-03 (ae008d6b; QueuePanel.jsx: "the heuristic was mis-firing … nothing greys or self-retires off a git guess"). Today a card closes by a handoff_closed citing a commit that exists (batons), a Palace-Resolves trailer that greys it for a person to confirm (weave flags), a person's GRANT or DENY on the board (proposals, entry flags, to-dos), or a person's clear. The door checks that a cited hash is a commit, not that it holds the work.

Rung 3 says lease expiry and pheromone that evaporates unless refreshed "turn out to be the same mechanism". That holds when each heartbeat resets the scent to full (L = τ·ln(1/θ)); it does not when deposits add up, as Pheromone Trail's "reinforced" pheromone does — a frequent beater's scent then outlives its lease after death. And "the liveness heartbeat the palace already emits on every message" overstates it: every message carries a health block, whose score is a green stub on Path-2 and hand-authored lines (SCHEMA — Reference §9), and a catcher deep in a move posts nothing between claim and close.

Rung 1 does not stop a double catch. pickup-handoff.mjs warns when a card is already claimed and then claims it again (pickup-handoff.mjs:68-70), so two catchers who read inside the gap can both hold one baton. The page doesn't say so.
